requirements_summary: Workload: interactive product chat + search-as-you-type; median prompt length ~45 tokens; occasional long form summarization (<=800 tokens)
Targets: p95 latency goal for short chat messages <= 400ms; cold-start of larger summarization allowed up to 2.5s
Throughput: initial target 5-10 reqs/sec, burst tolerant
Cost: high sensitivity; prefer 7B-quantized or similar for most traffic, larger model as fallback
Routing/fallback: prefer region-first routing (closest region), auto-fallback to quantized variant on cost tier; can tolerate graceful degradation
Security: SSO for console, basic audit logs, retention 90 days
Operational: wants clear client timeout guidance and sample SDK config for streaming and non-streaming
perf_tuning_advice_shared: Recommendation 1: Move stable production traffic to closest region — us-east-1 for NA customers. Run quick A/B: eu-west-1 vs us-east-1 to measure RTT improvements
Recommendation 2: Enable streaming for short chat messages: client-side socket timeout = 10s, overall request deadline = 30s. Start with read-timeout 10s to show first token quickly
Recommendation 3: Use quantized 7B variant for 80% of traffic (edge responses). Reserve 13B for high-accuracy summarization, with automatic fallback configured in routing policy
Recommendation 4: Trim system prompts + limit max_tokens for short interactions (suggest: max_tokens=64 for quick chat completions). Encourage client-side prompt shortening for search-as-you-type
Recommendation 5: Turn on prefix KV caching for repeated product descriptions; reduces per-token work and lowers median latency
Recommendation 6: Apply conservative batching window (5-10ms) to increase throughput without impacting p95 for low-latency flows
Recommendation 7: Run a 48-hour POC capturing p50/p95/p99 across regions and model variants; collect token-level cost metrics from Console
poC_plan: Step 1: POC env in us-east-1 with hosted_api, enable streaming + 7B-quantized; ingest 1k representative queries
Step 2: Measure p50/p95/p99, token costs, and failure modes over 48 hours
Step 3: Re-run with eu-west-1 + identical workload to show delta
Step 4: Implement routing policy: prefer region then fallback to quantized model; validate no silent quality regressions on critical queries
Step 5: Demo results with visual dashboards and cost/latency breakdown to Celina and engineering lead
next_call_objective: Schedule 30-min technical POC kickoff with engineering (walk through SDK timeout flags, streaming example, and active monitoring in Console)
